title: Addresses to file offsets

milestone.title: Ground Rules, Tools and the PE Format

description:
Convert between RVAs and file offsets using the section table.

```
RVA 0x1500 -> in .text -> file offset 0x900
RVA 0x4100 -> in .data -> file offset 0x3100
RVA 0x4250 -> in .data but past its raw data -> zero-filled, no file offset
RVA 0x9000 -> not in any section
```
hints: Inside the section but at or past `va + rsize` means "in memory, not in the file".
requirements: `rvaToOffset(sections, rva)` returns an offset or nothing.
A section covers `virtualAddress` to `virtualAddress + max(virtualSize, rawSize)`.
Bytes beyond the raw size exist in memory only (zeros).
stretch: Do the reverse: a file offset back to an RVA.
